items.text: Two transcriptions of one recording are not redundant when one carries speakers. The platform's own caption export attributes all 855 filed cues and settled a question faster-whisper could not: who was teaching. The first draft of §2 had the guiding role assigned from narration and would have been wrong about it — the session was set up for one person to guide and a different person did. Where a claim's weight depends on who made it, an unattributed transcript is not enough, and principle 4 rests exactly there.
